package com.retronpcswapper;

/**
 * NPC classification category for Retro NPC Swapper config toggles.
 */
public enum RetroNpcCategory
{
	LESSER_DEMONS,
	GREATER_DEMONS,
	BLACK_DEMONS,
	ADULT_DRAGONS,
	BABY_DRAGONS,
	GOBLINS,
	GUARDS,
	IMPS,
	SKELETONS,
	SKELETON_MAGES,
	ZOMBIES,
	GHOSTS,
	HILL_GIANTS,
	FIRE_GIANTS,
	ICE_GIANTS,
	MOSS_GIANTS,
	CYCLOPS,
	CHICKENS,
	COWS,
	HELLHOUNDS,
	GIANT_RATS,
	SCORPIONS,
	SMALL_SCORPIONS
}
